newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants Hai Hong in purchase talk.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants Hai Hong in purchase talk.

text.p: China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it is in preliminary talks to acquire certain investments from its parent China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd.
The acquisitions, if implemented, would require fund raising by the company but no decision has been made in the form of such fund raising, the company said in a statement.

"It is emphasised that no terms have been agreed and no decision to proceed has been taken by either China Merchants Holdings or the company," it said, adding no indication could be given of the timing of any such decision to prceed.
The paint maker China Merchants Hai Hong raised a net of HK$446.6 million in January by issuing 141.22 million new shares to its parent.
It had said the money would be used for working capital and investment opportunities.
